tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhwa lu lhun chos ngor mdzad dge/ na mo gu ru shtsa shrī tsakra kā lā ya/ rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i rten bzang thob dus 'dir/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i don chen sgrub phyir du/ /sdom gsum bslab gsum ldan pa'i mkhas grub ni/ /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser mtshungs zhabs pad 'dud/ /dkon mchog la skyabs dpal ldan dus 'khor bsgom/ /bla ma dam pa dus 'khor yab yum dngos/ /thun mong khyad par mchod pas yongs mnyes nas/ /sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs 'phral yun don grub shog /ngag dbang lha rigs gzhon nu kun dga'i dus/ /mkhas grub rjes bzung blo gros sangs rgyas bstan/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i rgyan mtshan mngon mtho bas/ /dpal 'byor bzang po'i rnam thar sgrib med shar/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ haṃkṣamalawaraye hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ci nus bzlas nas/ bla ma dpal ldan dus 'khor byin rlabs kyis/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen mthar phyin te/ /phyi nang gzhan gyi yon tan lhun grub shog /ces 'di zhwa lu lhun chos kyis/ /'di 'dra gyis zhes ngo srung du/ /'chol por smra ba'i sa skya pa/ /kun blos gung thun de 'phral bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ zhwa lu lhun chos ngor mdzad dge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
